description: Tree T72, London plane (Platanus x hispanica)Proposed pruning specification:1. Selectively prune back the branches on the side of the crown facing the temporary structure to give a clearance of 1 m from the structure.2. Cut each branch back to a suitable growth point, such as a lateral branch or the branch collar, so the crown keeps a natural shape. Do not cut through branches part way along (no flush cuts, stubs or topping cuts).3. Remove only the growth needed to reach the clearance above. No other crown thinning, lifting or reduction is proposed.4. Carry out all work in line with BS 3998:2010 Tree work - Recommendations.Reason for the works:A temporary modular structure is erected on site as part of the construction works on the site. Branches on that side of the crown are encroaching upon and rubbing against it. The proposed pruning is required to:- stop branches being damaged by rubbing against the structure, or torn in high winds;- protect the structure and its fittings, including the external services and air-conditioning units; and- keep enough clearance for the structure to be used and maintained safely.The works are limited to the part of the crown next to the temporary structure. They are the least intervention required to remedy the encroachment.
